name: Veil demon
description: a slim purple-grey demon of the Cracked Road wearing a shimmering translucent veil over its front and holding a small round shield, violet glow beneath the veil

poses.stand: standing, veil drawn across its front, shield raised, violet shimmer, facing right
poses.struck: struck: veil rippling and tearing, the shield ringing
poses.dead: torn veil settled over a collapsed demon, violet glow fading

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
